episodes.name: Arrival
episodes.plot: After meeting her unconventional roommates, Mia attends her first class with Dr. Lorenz and cozies up to the professor's research assistant, Jasper.

translations.value: After meeting her unconventional roommates, Mia attends her first class with Dr. Lorenz and cozies up to the professor's research assistant, Jasper.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.plot: Mia tries to wheedle her way into a job at Dr. Lorenz's biomedical institute but runs into a problem when she's asked to participate in a genetic study.

translations.value: Mia tries to wheedle her way into a job at Dr. Lorenz's biomedical institute but runs into a problem when she's asked to participate in a genetic study.

episodes.name: Suspicion
episodes.plot: Mia's night out with Jasper leads to Dr. Lorenz's private residence, where a medical emergency complicates her plans to access the professor's computer.

episodes.name: Certainty
episodes.plot: Dr. Lorenz's growing suspicions cause Jasper to question his relationship with Mia, who finds a new confidante in her desperate search for answers.

translations.value: Dr. Lorenz's growing suspicions cause Jasper to question his relationship with Mia, who finds a new confidante in her desperate search for answers.

episodes.name: Betrayal
episodes.plot: As Mia makes a last-ditch effort to obtain proof about Dr. Lorenz's experiments, Jasper begins to unravel over his feelings of betrayal.

translations.value: As Mia makes a last-ditch effort to obtain proof about Dr. Lorenz's experiments, Jasper begins to unravel over his feelings of betrayal.

episodes.name: Fate
episodes.plot: On the run and with time running out, Mia turns to her friends for help in a life-and-death race to save the train's passengers.

translations.value: On the run and with time running out, Mia turns to her friends for help in a life-and-death race to save the train's passengers.

episodes.name: Awake
episodes.plot: After waking up in class feeling disoriented, Mia grows increasingly distressed when she discovers nothing in her life is how she remembers it.

translations.value: After waking up in class feeling disoriented, Mia grows increasingly distressed when she discovers nothing in her life is how she remembers it.

episodes.name: Enemies
episodes.plot: Struggling with mysterious symptoms, Mia tries to track down Lorenz, certain that she will be able to provide answers about what's happening.

translations.value: Struggling with mysterious symptoms, Mia tries to track down Lorenz, certain that she will be able to provide answers about what's happening.

episodes.name: Partners
episodes.plot: Mia strikes an uneasy bargain that could help get to the bottom of her missing memories. But upholding her side of the deal means flirting with danger.

translations.value: Mia strikes an uneasy bargain that could help get to the bottom of her missing memories. But upholding her side of the deal means flirting with danger.

episodes.name: Forget
episodes.plot: As Mia's feelings toward Jasper begin to change, her friends aid her desperate search for information by engaging in some high-tech espionage.

translations.value: As Mia's feelings toward Jasper begin to change, her friends aid her desperate search for information by engaging in some high-tech espionage.

episodes.name: Find
episodes.plot: With time running out, Mia sets a risky plan in motion to uncover the secret lab and find a solution to her rapidly deteriorating neurological state.

episodes.plot: Loyalties are tested after Mia locates the red notebook, with lines drawn between the friends amid a last-ditch effort to save her life.

translations.title: Biohacker
translations.overview: Ammessa in una prestigiosa università tedesca, una studentessa di medicina deve smascherare un complotto che lega una tragedia familiare e una professoressa di biologia.
A medical student enters a top German university on a secret mission to uncover a conspiracy linking a family tragedy to a visionary biology professor.
Mia beginnt ein Medizinstudium, um das Vertrauen einer Dozentin zu gewinnen, mit der sie ein dunkles Geheimnis verbindet, und wird in illegale Genexperimente verwickelt.
translations.tagline: Finde heraus, woraus du gemacht bist.

overview.value: Ammessa in una prestigiosa università tedesca, una studentessa di medicina deve smascherare un complotto che lega una tragedia familiare e una professoressa di biologia.
Tormentata dal tempo mancante e da visioni inquietanti, Mia cerca di capire gli improvvisi cambiamenti nella sua vita e il motivo per cui non riesce a ricordarli...
